blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Visayas grid was placed on yellow alert Monday afternoon as outages and higher demand squeezed reserves, raising the risk of power interruptions for households. In an advisory, the National Grid Corp. of the Philippines (NGCP) said the yellow alert would be in effect from 4 p.m. to 8 p.m. READ: Power supply woes in Visayas, Mindanao extend to September Available capacity stood at 2,500 megawatts (MW) against a projected peak demand of 2,426 MW, leaving a margin of only 74 MW.
